ash: perf-bot just opened an alert for nightly-ci small-batch p95 spike :mag_right:
perf-bot: nightly-ci run 2026-03-18 02:12 UTC — p95 increased from 160ms -> 260ms (40% delta). sample-id=ci-20260318-02-small-7, trace: https://perf.redwood/s/ci-20260318-02-small-7 :warning:
ash: attaching the minimal log snippet from the runner:
```
[2026-03-18T02:12:03Z] small_batch_worker: start batch id=7
[2026-03-18T02:12:03Z] exec_path: small_batch->kvcache->decode
[2026-03-18T02:12:03Z] latency: 162ms
[2026-03-18T02:12:05Z] latency: 258ms  <-- outlier
```
ash: looks like the slow path correlates with kvcache touched + small seq lenses. anyone able to repro locally quickly? :thinking_face:
devon: I can take a stab. which commit range did nightly run pick up? need that for a quick bisect.
ash: CI run used commit range: a1b2c3d..f6e7d8c (master->head-nightly). suspecting recent scheduler change or kvcache eviction tweak.
maria: I can repro a reduced workload on my devbox. trying `./tools/bench/small_batch --seed 7 --workers 2 --kv=true --trace` now. will paste results.
maria: ran once, p95 ~ 255ms here too. logs show extra GC-ish stall in python shim around kv flush.
liam: quick test idea: can you try with kv disabled? `--kv=false` if that removes the regression we narrow to kv module.
maria: good call — running `./tools/bench/small_batch --seed 7 --kv=false`
maria: result: p95 165ms, looks normal. so KV path implicated. :thumbsup:
devon: ok that narrows it. i'll start a git bisect between a1b2c3d..f6e7d8c with `git bisect run ci/regress-check.sh` and see which commit introduces the extra kv flush.
nash: can you also add `--trace` to the bisect runner so we capture perf traces? saves repeat work.
devon: good idea. updating the script now.
perf-bot: scheduled a trace capture job for bisect devon-20260318-02, storing artifacts at s3://perf-artifacts/ci/bisect/devon-20260318-02\.zip
liam: FYI there's a recent change in scheduler that touched eviction timing (PR #4123). worth checking if bisect points there.
oncall: i'm switching to oncall context, will shadow the bisect and pick up if it points to infra. ping me if it hits PR #4123.
nash: thanks team. devon, lmk when bisect lands a culprit and we'll open a hotfix branch. if it's a config tweak we can patch and rerun nightly quick.
devon: starting bisect now, will update in this thread with the first failing commit. aim <= 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: leaving a short repro checklist in the thread for anyone jumping in:
- run `./tools/bench/small_batch --seed 7 --workers 2 --kv=true --trace`
- compare p95 to baseline (~160ms)
- if p95 > 200ms attach trace id and short log snippet
- try `--kv=false` to confirm KV path

ash: perfect. thanks. if anyone else sees similar spikes in other nightly flavors pls post sample links.
perf-bot: alert status: acknowledged by devon. artifact collection in progress. :white_check_mark:
oncall: i'm around if you need me to take over bisect or cut a draft PR.
